site_area_sqm.formula: polygon_area(SITE-001 projected from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Recomputed from the repository provisional boundary; not an official redline area or statutory control.

green_space_area_sqm.formula: union_area(features where layer=GREEN_SPACE, projected to EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Concept design area inside the provisional boundary; not an approved green-line area.

public_space_area_sqm.formula: union_area(polygon features where layer=PUBLIC_SPACE, projected to EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Point scenario nodes have zero area; concept band is not an official public-space boundary.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: union_area(BLDG-ZZY-001, BLDG-ORIGIN-001, BLDG-DZS-001 projected to EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Three concept prototype footprints only; not existing-building survey, demolition classification, confirmed floor area or approved envelope.

human_fallback_scenario_count.formula: count(SCENARIO_NODE features with a non-empty human_fallback property)
assumptions: Records a design requirement; it does not verify staffing, service quality or legal compliance.

prototype_landmark_count.formula: count(BUILDING_FOOTPRINT features with linked_key_area_id and landmark_role)
assumptions: Counts conceptual prototypes, not confirmed buildings or projects.
Three names and approximate areas follow the announcement, while polygons remain provisional.
Counts review gateways, not a committed land-development or construction schedule.
Uses provisional key-area geometry solely to index three gateway reviews; not an implementation or investment area.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls, official site polygon and verified building floor area are absent.

building_height_max_m.reason: Official height controls, heritage/view-corridor constraints and a current building survey are absent.

building_density_ratio.reason: Submitted footprints are three design prototypes, not a complete existing/proposed building dataset.

road_redline_width_m.reason: No official road redlines or engineering alignments are supplied; concept centerlines cannot determine width.

municipal_capacity_index.reason: Utility networks, loads, reserve capacity, asset condition and emergency redundancy data are absent.

human_takeover_completion_rate.reason: No pilot has operated; baseline, denominator rules and review threshold must be agreed before deployment.

accessible_journey_completion_rate.reason: Venue surveys and co-tests with disabled and older participants have not occurred.

complaint_closure_rate.reason: No operator, complaint channel, reporting period or observed service record is confirmed.

energy_per_service_task.reason: Hardware, model, workload, metering boundary and operational baseline are unknown; unit must be fixed by the future operator.

heat_comfort_coverage_ratio.reason: Microclimate baseline, seasonal observation, canopy survey and professional thermal-comfort method are absent.
